description: Left text + right image/illustration 50/50
why_bad: Most overused layout since 2020. Screams 'template'.
alternative: Asymmetric 90/10, massive typography hero, vertical narrative, overlapping layers

description: 3 equal columns with icon + heading + text
why_bad: Every SaaS landing page default. Zero memorability.
alternative: Staggered cards, bento asymmetric, timeline flow, diagonal layout

description: All content center-aligned, symmetrical
why_bad: Safe but forgettable. No visual tension or hierarchy.
alternative: Off-center composition, left-heavy asymmetry, edge-anchored elements

description: Hero → Features → Testimonials → Pricing → CTA → Footer in exact order
why_bad: Cookie-cutter structure. Users know what comes next.
alternative: Interrupt with unexpected sections, embed CTA mid-content, story-driven flow

description: Uniform grid of identical cards with same dimensions
why_bad: Monotonous rhythm, no visual surprise.
alternative: Varied card sizes, masonry, overlapping cards, featured card breakout

description: Purple/violet/indigo as AI-default choice (not explicitly requested)
why_bad: #1 AI-generated color. When chosen without user input, instantly signals 'AI made this'. When explicitly chosen by user or matching brand (Twitch/Figma/GitHub) it's perfectly valid.
alternative: Ask user first. If no preference: deep red, acid green, warm orange, monochrome black, earth tones

description: Light blue primary + white background + gray text
why_bad: Generic fintech/SaaS palette. 90% of AI output uses this.
alternative: High contrast pairs: black+neon, navy+gold, forest+cream

description: Soft muted pastels across all elements
why_bad: Looks unfinished, lacks confidence. No visual punch.
alternative: Saturated accent on muted base, dopamine color pops, high-contrast duotone

description: Colorful mesh/aurora gradient backgrounds
why_bad: Was trendy in 2022, now an AI cliché.
alternative: Solid colors with grain texture, sharp geometric patterns, photographic backgrounds

description: Blur + transparency + thin border cards
why_bad: Overused since iOS 7. AI loves it. Users are bored.
alternative: Solid cards with shadows, neumorphic depth, raw borders, paper texture

description: Inter or Roboto as primary font
why_bad: The most 'AI default' font choice. Zero personality.
alternative: Space Grotesk, Clash Display, Satoshi, Cabinet Grotesk, custom variable fonts

description: All headings similar size, weak hierarchy
why_bad: No visual drama. Content feels flat.
alternative: Extreme size contrast: 120px H1 + 16px body, typographic scale ratio 1.618+

description: Long paragraphs center-aligned
why_bad: Hard to read, looks amateurish beyond 2 lines.
alternative: Left-aligned body, max-width 65ch, proper reading rhythm

description: Only using system/UI fonts for everything
why_bad: Misses opportunity for brand personality.
alternative: Display font for headings + UI font for body. Contrast creates character.

description: Only opacity transitions on elements
why_bad: Bare minimum effort. Not 'animated', just 'appearing'.
alternative: Spring physics, stagger reveals, scroll-driven parallax, kinetic typography

description: Hover effect is just opacity: 0.8
why_bad: Lazy interaction. No physical feedback.
alternative: Scale + translateY + shadow shift, magnetic cursor effect, color morph

description: Static page with no scroll-triggered effects
why_bad: Dead page. No engagement. Users scroll and leave.
alternative: Scroll-driven animations API, intersection observer reveals, parallax layers

description: All animations use linear or ease timing
why_bad: Robotic movement. No organic feel.
alternative: Spring physics (mass/stiffness/damping), custom cubic-bezier, step easing for retro

description: Excessive bounce/elastic on every element
why_bad: Distracting, unprofessional, carnival feel.
alternative: Reserve bounce for CTAs only. Use subtle spring for everything else.

description: Auto-rotating testimonial slider with stars
why_bad: Most ignored section on any website. Template energy.
alternative: Video testimonials, tweet embeds, case study cards, metric-based proof

description: Abstract vector illustration in hero section
why_bad: Humaaans/unDraw style = instant 'startup template' feel.
alternative: Custom photography, 3D renders, kinetic typography, data visualization

description: Hiding navigation behind hamburger on desktop
why_bad: Reduces discoverability, looks lazy.
alternative: Full nav bar, mega menu, sidebar navigation for complex apps

description: 4-column footer with lorem ipsum links
why_bad: Afterthought design. No brand closure.
alternative: Branded footer with CTA, animated background, creative layout

description: 3-column pricing with 'Popular' badge on middle
why_bad: Most AI-generated pattern. Users immune to it.
alternative: Interactive pricing slider, feature comparison tool, use-case based tiers

description: Using words: Empower, Elevate, Seamless, Orchestrate, Leverage
why_bad: Corporate AI buzzwords. Zero meaning to users.
alternative: Specific verbs: Ship, Build, Track, Save. Concrete benefits over abstractions.

description: Opening with 'In today's rapidly evolving...'
why_bad: #1 AI slop indicator. Reader closes tab.
alternative: Start with a surprising stat, provocative question, or bold claim.

description: Placeholder text left in production
why_bad: Screams unfinished. Trust killer.
alternative: Real content always. Even draft copy is better than lorem ipsum.

description: Same padding/margin everywhere (p-8 or p-6)
why_bad: Monotonous rhythm. No breathing room variation.
alternative: Vary spacing: tight groups for related items, generous space for separation. Use 8px grid.

description: Every area filled with content/elements
why_bad: Cluttered, overwhelming, no focus point.
alternative: Strategic whitespace: let key elements breathe. 40%+ negative space in hero.

description: Content appears with no transition or skeleton
why_bad: Jarring experience. Feels broken during load.
alternative: Skeleton screens, progressive image loading, shimmer effects

description: No visual feedback for errors/empty states
why_bad: Users confused when things go wrong.
alternative: Friendly error illustrations, inline validation, helpful empty states

description: Content loads with no progress indicator
why_bad: Users don't know if more content exists.
alternative: Load more button, progress bar, 'Showing X of Y' counter
